bayts.text: I have held within the Qurʾān a secret that must remain, forever, veiled.
I recite the Book, well pleased with Him Who sent (it) down, Who is well pleased with me, effacing my wavering.
May the best Self-Sufficient One (Aṣ-Ṣamad) bless our master Muḥammad, greeting him with peace.
The Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ) has bestowed benefits on me, (making me), through Him, free of need for defenders.
He Who protected me from hypocrisy has effaced my faults, through the Chosen One, who surpassed all creation.
The peace of Him Who accepted from me the (religious) obligation upon him through whom I paid off the debt.
My heart has rejoiced at the turning toward me of my Lord's reward, for what I have written in rajaz metre.
There has turned to me, from the Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), the adornment of the Everlasting, without obscurity.
The Enricher (Al-Mughnī) has made me a master, (free) of kings through Him, and through al-Māḥī (free) of the initiatic wayfaring.
Allah has set me before the servants, through the Chosen One who makes the footsteps firm.
I have obtained the gifts without earning (by my own strength), but through God, and God suffices me.
The Everlasting, the Beautiful, has extended to me a succour, through the Chosen One who made my tongue upright.
Our Prophet Aḥmad is my provision (toward) God; through him Allah has spared me the harm of every heedless one.
I have been lavish toward him, ever since I reached discernment, with the pens; and (he) has led to me what effaced all blame.
The Bountiful (Al-Mannān) has favoured me with aspirations, and through the Prophet the heart grows pure for me.
The Supreme Judge (Ad-Dayyān) has favoured me with purity, and through the Prophet disobedience has left me.
The hearts of the people of Allah have turned toward me, by the rank of an Effacer (al-Māḥī) whose loftiness has shone upon me.
The praises of the Best of the worlds have drawn out of me the faults of the soul, and they have gone out.
Muḥammad: his outward purifies the outward of whoever aspires to purification.
Our Prophet: his inward sanctifies, purifies whoever has been seized by darkness.
His praise has drawn to me, in secret, my whole being, and has spared (it) harm and evil.
My worship is the affirmation of my Lord's Oneness and the praise of him who drove the idol toward others than me.
The peace of Him Who is exalted above all likeness upon the Prophet who surpasses (his) peers.
To me Allah has led, through the Prophet, the glad tidings of “There is no god but Allah”.
The Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad) has effaced the turning of harm toward me, from before, through him who is the Prophet Muḥammad.
Toward others than me the Antichrist (ad-Dajjāl) turns, with all that is allied to him, and the fears.
God, through the Prophet, has severed forever (every tie) between me and all that is not praiseworthy.
The prowling (around me) of whoever does not worship Allah has turned toward others than me, and good pleasure turns toward me.
Glory be to Him Who, toward the Gardens, has preserved my whole being, (I) a servant holding fast to Him.
